name: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
creator: org-manchester

architecture.notes: Philosophical and mathematical foundation of artificial intelligence and machine learning.

summary: Alan Turing introduces the Imitation Game (Turing Test) and proposes that machines could learn from experience akin to human children.
key_innovations: The Imitation Game / Operational definition of machine intelligence
Concept of 'child-machine' trained via reward/punishment
Prediction of digital computer chess and language mastery

name: Mark I Perceptron
creator: org-cornell

architecture.notes: Custom analog hardware implementation with 400 photocells connected to potentiometers driven by electric motors.

parameters.notes: 512 variable potentiometers adjusted by motorized servo rheostats.

summary: The first physical neural network machine capable of learning linear classification boundaries from visual stimuli.
key_innovations: Perceptron learning algorithm with provable convergence
Motorized analog weight adjustment
Optical 20x20 cadmium sulfide sensor matrix
known_limitations: Cannot compute non-linearly separable functions like XOR (Minsky & Papert 1969)

name: Backpropagation for Multi-Layer Networks
creator: org-ucsd

architecture.notes: Gradient descent through hidden representations using the chain rule.

summary: Demonstrated that generalized delta rule backpropagation enables hidden neural units to learn non-linear internal representations.
key_innovations: Hidden representation discovery in multi-layer perceptrons
Systematic solution to Minsky's XOR limitation
Foundation for all modern gradient-based neural learning

name: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)
creator: org-idsia

architecture.notes: Constant Error Carousel (CEC) with input and output gates (forget gate added 1999).

summary: Breakthrough recurrent architecture that resolved vanishing and exploding gradients, enabling networks to bridge 1,000+ time steps.
key_innovations: Constant Error Carousel maintaining linear error flow
Multiplicative gating mechanism
Foundation for machine translation and speech from 2000 to 2017

name: LeNet-5
creator: org-att

architecture.notes: 2 convolutional layers, 2 average pooling layers, 2 fully connected layers, 1 output layer.

summary: Landmark convolutional neural network deployed by US banks to read over 10% of all checks written in the United States in the late 1990s.
key_innovations: Shift, scale, and distortion invariance via shared convolution kernels
Sub-sampling / pooling hierarchy
End-to-end gradient-based document recognition

name: NVIDIA CUDA Architecture
creator: org-nvidia

architecture.notes: Programmable parallel thread arrays accessible through standard C/C++ APIs.

summary: Unified GPU computing platform that transitioned graphics cards into universal massively parallel matrix processors.
key_innovations: Hardware SIMT thread scheduling
Massive memory bandwidth exceeding CPUs by 10x
The underlying compute substrate for the deep learning revolution

name: AlexNet
creator: org-utoronto

architecture.notes: Trained across two NVIDIA GeForce GTX 580 (3GB) GPUs.

summary: The catalyst for the modern deep learning revolution. Smashed prior computer vision records on ImageNet 2012 by a staggering 10.8 percentage point margin.
key_innovations: Non-saturating ReLU activations (6x faster convergence than tanh)
Dropout regularization (0.5 rate) preventing overfitting
Custom CUDA cross-GPU parallel kernels

name: Word2Vec
creator: org-google

architecture.notes: Continuous Bag-of-Words and Skip-gram architectures with negative sampling.

summary: Pioneered dense semantic vector embeddings where arithmetic operations capture semantic relationships (King - Man + Woman = Queen).
key_innovations: Distributed representation of words in low-dimensional continuous vector space
Hierarchical softmax & negative sampling for O(1) training scaling
Geometric semantic compositionality

name: Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN)
creator: org-umontreal
creator_name: Ian Goodfellow et al. / Univ. of Montreal

architecture.notes: Simultaneous game between generator network G(z) and discriminator network D(x).

summary: Introduced adversarial zero-sum training framework that revolutionized neural image synthesis without Markov chains or intractable likelihood calculations.
key_innovations: Adversarial zero-sum training framework
Implicit probability distribution modeling
Sparked deep generative visual modeling from 2014 to 2021

name: Deep Residual Networks (ResNet)
creator: org-msr
creator_name: Kaiming He et al. / Microsoft Research

architecture.notes: Identity shortcut mapping F(x) + x allowing unhindered gradient propagation.

summary: Solved the degradation problem in extremely deep networks using identity skip connections, surpassing human classification performance on ImageNet.
key_innovations: Identity residual shortcut connections
First successful optimization of 152+ layer deep networks
Surpassed human baseline accuracy (5.1%) with 3.57% top-5 error

name: AlphaGo
creator: org-deepmind

architecture.notes: 12-layer deep convolutional policy network + value evaluation network coupled to Monte Carlo Tree Search.

summary: First computer program to defeat a human 9-dan professional world champion (Lee Sedol, 4-1) in the ancient board game of Go.
key_innovations: Deep policy and value network integration with asynchronous MCTS
Supervised pretraining on 30M moves + self-play reinforcement learning
Discovered creative intuitive plays such as Move 37

name: Google TPU v1
creator: org-google

architecture.notes: 256x256 8-bit matrix multiply unit operating at 700MHz, delivering 92 TOPS.

summary: Google's custom 28nm ASIC designed specifically for neural network inference, powering Google Search, Photos, and AlphaGo.
key_innovations: Systolic array architecture streaming 65,536 8-bit operations per cycle
Deterministic execution without branch predictors or cache hierarchies
15x-30x speedup per watt compared to contemporary CPUs and GPUs

name: Transformer (Attention Is All You Need)
creator: org-google
creator_name: Ashish Vaswani et al. / Google Brain

architecture.notes: Scaled dot-product attention: Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V.

parameters.notes: 65M parameters in base, 213M in big model.

summary: The single most influential architecture in modern AI. Eliminated recurrence entirely in favor of parallelized multi-head self-attention mechanisms.
key_innovations: Multi-Head Scaled Dot-Product Self-Attention
Full sequence parallelization during training (O(1) sequential operations vs O(n) in RNNs)
Sinusoidal positional encodings
Foundation for all modern LLMs, Vision Transformers, and Multimodal systems

name: BERT
creator: org-google
creator_name: Jacob Devlin et al. / Google AI

architecture.notes: 24 layers, 1024 hidden dimension, 16 attention heads.

summary: Established the paradigm of self-supervised pre-training on unlabeled text followed by lightweight fine-tuning across NLP benchmarks.
key_innovations: Masked Language Modeling (MLM) objective
Deep bidirectional context encoding
Standardized fine-tuning paradigm across NLP

name: GPT-2
creator: org-openai

architecture.notes: 48 layers, 1600 hidden dimension, modified layer normalization at pre-activation.

summary: Proved that language models trained on massive internet text without explicit supervision act as zero-shot multitask learners.
key_innovations: Zero-shot transfer across diverse NLP tasks
WebText dataset curation (8 million curated web pages)
Coherent long-form synthetic text generation

name: GPT-3
creator: org-openai

architecture.notes: 96 layers, 12,288 hidden dimension, 96 attention heads, alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention.

summary: Demonstrated that scaling autoregressive language models to 175B parameters produces strong in-context few-shot learning capabilities across diverse cognitive domains.
key_innovations: In-context few-shot prompting without gradient updates
Empirical validation of neural scaling laws
Sparked the commercial Generative AI boom via API access

name: AlphaFold 2
creator: org-deepmind
creator_name: John Jumper et al. / Google DeepMind

architecture.notes: Pair representations interacting with Multiple Sequence Alignments (MSA) via equivariant 3D geometry transformations.

summary: Solved the 50-year-old biological grand challenge of predicting 3D protein structures directly from primary amino acid sequences with atomic accuracy.
key_innovations: Evoformer architecture processing sequence evolution and residue pairs simultaneously
Invariant Point Attention (IPA) operating directly in 3D rigid body space
Predicted structures for over 200 million cataloged proteins

name: CLIP
creator: org-openai

architecture.notes: InfoNCE contrastive symmetric cross-entropy loss between image and text embeddings.

summary: Trained dual visual and text encoders on 400M internet image-caption pairs using contrastive loss, enabling robust zero-shot visual classification.
key_innovations: Scalable multimodal contrastive pretraining
Zero-shot visual classification matching supervised ResNet-50
The semantic text-guidance conditioning backbone for Stable Diffusion and DALL-E 2

name: InstructGPT
creator: org-openai

architecture.type: Decoder Transformer with PPO RLHF Alignment
architecture.notes: 3-stage pipeline: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reward Model training, PPO Reinforcement Learning.

parameters.notes: Also evaluated at 1.3B and 6B parameter scales.

summary: Pioneered the application of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to align language models with human user instructions, forming the direct engine of ChatGPT.
key_innovations: 3-stage RLHF alignment recipe (SFT → Reward Model → PPO)
1.3B parameter InstructGPT preferred by human raters over 175B raw GPT-3
Dramatic reduction in toxic hallucinations and evasive outputs

name: Stable Diffusion (v1.4 / v1.5)
creator: org-stability
creator_name: Robin Rombach et al. / Stability AI & LMU

architecture.subtype: UNet with Cross-Attention + VAE + CLIP Text Encoder
architecture.notes: 860M parameter UNet operating in 4x downsampled latent space of a pretrained VAE.

parameters.notes: Approx 1.0 billion total across UNet, Text Encoder, and VAE.

summary: Democratized generative image synthesis by operating in a compressed latent space, allowing photorealistic 512x512 image generation on consumer 8GB GPUs.
key_innovations: Latent space diffusion reducing compute requirements by orders of magnitude
Open weights release triggering an explosion of fine-tunes (ControlNet, LoRA)
Cross-attention conditioning on CLIP text tokens

name: NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU
creator: org-nvidia

architecture.type: TSMC 4N Hopper Architecture with Transformer Engine
architecture.notes: 80 billion transistors, 80GB HBM3 memory at 3.35 TB/s, NVLink 4 (900 GB/s).

summary: The definitive compute workhorse of the modern LLM boom. Introduced hardware Transformer Engines with FP8 precision to accelerate attention training by up to 6x.
key_innovations: Transformer Engine dynamically managing FP8 and FP16 precision
4th Generation Tensor Cores delivering 4,000 TFLOPS FP8
DPX instructions accelerating dynamic programming algorithms

name: LLaMA (1)
creator: org-meta
creator_name: Hugo Touvron et al. / Meta AI

architecture.notes: RMSNorm, SwiGLU activations, Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE).

summary: Proved that smaller models trained beyond Chinchilla optimal compute points on public data can match proprietary giants, sparking the open-source LLM movement.
key_innovations: Trained on 1.4 Trillion tokens of strictly public datasets
Adoption of RoPE, RMSNorm, and SwiGLU as modern architectural standards
Catalyzed local open-source inference ecosystems (llama.cpp, Ollama)

name: GPT-4
creator: org-openai

architecture.notes: Detailed architecture, total parameters, and compute breakdown were not publicly disclosed in the technical report.

parameters.notes: Not publicly disclosed by OpenAI. Industry estimates suggest 16-expert MoE ~1.8T total parameters.

summary: The landmark frontier model that defined the generative AI era, demonstrating human-level performance across standardized professional tests and vision-language tasks.
key_innovations: Multimodal input capability accepting interleaved text and visual diagrams
Predictable scaling: loss accurately predicted 10,000x ahead on small compute runs
Top 10th percentile performance on the Uniform Bar Exam and USABO Biology Olympiad

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
creator: org-anthropic

architecture.notes: Architectural internals not publicly disclosed.

summary: Frontier intelligence model renowned for state-of-the-art coding, complex visual reasoning, and autonomous multi-step computer use capabilities.
key_innovations: Industry-leading SWE-bench software engineering pass rates
Computer Use API enabling direct interaction with desktop GUI environments
200,000 token context window with near-perfect needle-in-a-haystack retrieval

name: Llama 3.1 405B
creator: org-meta

architecture.notes: 126 layers, 16,384 hidden dimension, 128 attention heads with 8 Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) key-value heads.

summary: The largest and most capable openly licensed foundation model ever trained, competitive with top closed models on 15.6T tokens across 16,000 H100 GPUs.
key_innovations: First open-weights model matching proprietary frontier systems (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5)
Synthetic data generation and distillation teacher for smaller open models
128k context window supported via iterative RoPE base frequency scaling

name: OpenAI o1
creator: org-openai

architecture.notes: Trained with large-scale reinforcement learning to produce internal chains of thought before generating output tokens.

summary: Pioneered the test-time compute paradigm, spending dynamic compute thinking through complex problems before answering, achieving PhD-level performance in physics, chemistry, and mathematics.
key_innovations: Test-time compute scaling laws: performance improves monotonically with reasoning time
Autonomous error correction and backtrack search during chain-of-thought
Surpassed human IMO gold medalist qualifiers on competitive math problems

name: DeepSeek-V3
creator: org-deepseek

architecture.notes: 671B total parameters, 37B activated per token (8 routed + 1 shared), Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) for KV cache compression.

parameters.notes: 671 billion total parameters with 37 billion active per token.

summary: Achieved frontier-tier performance while drastically lowering training and serving costs via Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) and auxiliary-loss-free load balancing.
key_innovations: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) compressing KV cache by 93%
Auxiliary-loss-free load balancing strategy for MoE routing
DualPipe algorithm overlapping compute and cross-node communication
Total training cost of only $5.9M on 2,048 H800 GPUs

name: DeepSeek-R1
creator: org-deepseek

architecture.subtype: DeepSeek-V3 Base + GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization)
architecture.notes: Large-scale reinforcement learning using GRPO directly on base model without supervised cold-start.

parameters.notes: 671 billion total parameters with 37 billion active per token.

summary: Demonstrated that reasoning capabilities and reflection patterns emerge purely through large-scale reinforcement learning, matching closed reasoning models under fully open MIT licensing.
key_innovations: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) removing critic model overhead
Discovery of 'Aha moment' self-reflection and re-evaluation behaviors purely via RL
Distilled dense models (1.5B to 70B) transferring frontier reasoning to local devices

name: Llama 3.3 70B
creator: org-meta

architecture.notes: 70 billion dense parameters delivering prior 405B capability through synthetic data distillation and enhanced post-training.

summary: Delivers the industry-standard intelligence of Meta's flagship 405B model inside a lightweight 70B footprint, accessible on single-node GPU systems.
key_innovations: Distillation of 405B reasoning and knowledge into 70B parameters
128k context window with low latency inference
Massive cost reduction for enterprise open-weights deployment

name: QwQ-32B
creator: org-alibaba

architecture.notes: Large-scale reinforcement learning for long-horizon mathematical and algorithmic chain-of-thought.

summary: Pioneered open-weights test-time compute reasoning, demonstrating that a 32B model can match early proprietary reasoning systems on math benchmarks.
key_innovations: Open reasoning chain-of-thought generation in a 32B dense footprint
Competitive with closed reasoning models on MATH-500
Deep integration of recursive self-correction and reflection steps

name: NVIDIA Blackwell GB200 NVL72
creator: org-nvidia

architecture.type: Dual-Die 4NP Semiconductor with NVLink 5 Switch Spine
architecture.notes: 208 billion transistors across dual reticle-limit dies connected by 10 TB/s NV-HBI chip-to-chip link. 192GB HBM3e per GPU (8 TB/s).

summary: Massive 208-billion transistor dual-die AI accelerator system, connecting 72 Blackwell GPUs via NVLink 5 into a single giant 1.4 exaFLOPS inference engine.
key_innovations: 2nd Generation Transformer Engine supporting microscopic FP4 quantization
20 PFLOPS FP4 inference compute per dual-die GPU (30x faster inference vs H100)
Liquid-cooled NVLink spine interconnecting 72 GPUs with 130 TB/s bisection bandwidth

name: OpenAI o3
creator: org-openai

architecture.notes: Second-generation reasoning architecture allocating dynamic search and verification trees.

summary: State-of-the-art frontier reasoning model breaking the 87% barrier on ARC-AGI novel reasoning tasks and scoring 96.7% on the American Invitational Mathematics Examination.
key_innovations: Record ARC-AGI reasoning score (87.5%) bridging novel generalization gap
SWE-bench Verified pass rate exceeding 71% for end-to-end software patch generation
Multimodal test-time thinking across diagrams, code, and formal verification

name: Gemini 2.0 Pro
creator: org-deepmind

architecture.notes: Native audio, video, text, and code processing with integrated real-time streaming pipelines and 2M token context.

summary: Google's flagship agentic multimodal model offering 2,000,000 token context window, native sub-second live audio-video streaming, and autonomous multi-tool grounding.
key_innovations: Native bidirectional audio and live video streaming with low latency
Industry-standard 2 Million token context window with full fidelity recall
Deep grounding with Google Search, code execution sandbox, and external APIs

name: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
creator: org-anthropic

architecture.type: Hybrid Instant & Extended Thinking Multimodal Transformer
architecture.notes: Allows dynamic user-controlled reasoning token budgets while maintaining native low-latency agentic execution.

summary: The first hybrid frontier model combining standard low-latency generation with continuous extended thinking capabilities, dominating autonomous software engineering benchmarks.
key_innovations: Dynamic thinking budget control adjusting reasoning depth per request
State-of-the-art 70.3% pass rate on SWE-bench Verified coding tasks
Seamless integration of internal reasoning tokens with real-time tool chaining

name: NVIDIA Vera Rubin Architecture
creator: org-nvidia

architecture.type: 3nm Semiconductor Platform with HBM4 & Optical Interconnect
architecture.notes: 3nm TSMC manufacturing with 288GB HBM4 memory, Vera CPU integration, and NVLink 6 (3.6 TB/s per GPU).

summary: Next-generation 3nm accelerated compute architecture introducing 6th Generation Tensor Cores, HBM4 ultra-high-speed memory stacking, and co-packaged optical networking.
key_innovations: HBM4 3D memory architecture delivering up to 288GB per GPU at >12 TB/s
Co-packaged optical NVLink 6 interconnects eliminating copper cable attenuation
Vera CPU integrated on-package for zero-overhead host-to-device kernel launches
